# akeyless_policy_keys (Resource)

Policy Keys Resource



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `path` (String) The path the policy refers to

### Optional

- `allowed_algorithms` (List of String) Specify allowed key algorithms (e.g., [RSA2048,AES128GCM])
- `allowed_key_names` (List of String) Specify allowed protection key names
- `allowed_key_types` (List of String) Specify allowed key protection types (dfc, classic-key)
- `max_rotation_interval_days` (Number) Set the maximum rotation interval for automatic key rotation
- `object_types` (List of String) The object types this policy will apply to (items, targets)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
